question: Does the 2014 Tikub Lake fish survey full text provide reviewable evidence, and are its text or tables reusable?

bibliography.title: Freshwater Fishes of Tikub Lake, Tiaong, Quezon, Philippines

accessAndRights.publisherPage: The page exposes the abstract but requires login or registration to access the full text.
accessAndRights.authorUpload: ResearchGate identifies a public full-text upload by author Bonifacio V. Labatos Jr.; its page says content may be subject to copyright. The article text was reviewed in the public web view without signing in or bypassing a control.
accessAndRights.localCopy: No PDF was downloaded or retained in the workspace.
accessAndRights.itemSpecificLicense: No item-specific open license or permission for Table 1 or Table 2 was identified in the reviewed publisher or author-upload pages.
accessAndRights.decision: Keep the source as research-only. Do not reproduce its species tables or admit source-derived rows to the public app until reuse terms and taxonomy are independently reviewed.

studyAssessment.abstractSummary: The article reports 221 individuals and nine species from seven families, labelled by the authors as three native and six introduced. It names Giuris margaritacea and Poecilia sphenops as the two most abundant source labels.
studyAssessment.resultsStructure: The full text separates nine species listed as collected from four additional taxa listed as reported. Do not merge reported-only taxa with survey captures.
studyAssessment.samplingDesign: The paper describes ten Tikub Lake sampling points, six near the shore and four in open water, and combines beach seine, traps, gill net and hook-and-line sampling. Collection is described as 10:00-15:00. A complete dated sampling period was not found in the reviewed methods/results text.
studyAssessment.identification: The authors state specimens were brought to a laboratory and identified using listed taxonomic references. No voucher repository catalogue numbers or independently reviewed specimen determinations were established in this source-access review.
studyAssessment.sourceTaxonomy: The 2014 source names are preserved as printed. Native/introduced labels, hybrids, historical reports and taxonomic combinations require separate crosswalk and should not be silently normalized.
studyAssessment.locality: The source identifies Tikub Lake in Tiaong, Quezon and provides a center coordinate, but this review adds no shoreline geometry or sampling-point coordinates.

decision.fullTextAccessGapResolvedForReview: The text is publicly visible as an author upload, although publisher access is gated.
decision.reason: The full article text can be reviewed through a public author upload, but the platform displays a copyright warning and no item-specific license was found. Historical catch labels therefore remain a research lead rather than public species records.

nextAction: Seek item-specific reuse clarification from the publisher or rights holder before transcribing the tables or admitting source-derived rows. In parallel, prefer independently licensed fish-survey sources and use a separate taxonomic crosswalk for any future consideration of the 2014 source labels.

sources.supports: Publisher article metadata, abstract, and full-text login/registration gate.
Public author-uploaded full text and displayed copyright warning.
